planets.name: TIC 294329732 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TIC 294329732 with a 9.76-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TIC 294329732 b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TIC 294329732. Its orbit and size follow Lafarga et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
